name: analysis.cross_section
description: Draw a line on the map and answer how the ground under it rises and falls.

layer.description: Layer id or name to run along, instead of the two points.

samples.description: How many points to read the elevation at, 10 to 200. 100 by default.

name: analysis.flood
description: Flood the ground under a water level and draw what it covers.

level_m.description: Water level in metres above sea level.

bbox.description: Where to flood, as [west, south, east, north] in degrees. The current view by default.

name: analysis.spatial_stats
description: Bin one layer's points into a grid and reduce each cell, drawn as extruded cells on the map.

layer.description: Layer id or name to read the points from.

method.description: How a cell reduces the points in it. count by default.

property.description: Numeric property sum and mean weigh. count ignores it.

cell_size.description: Cell side in metres, 50 to 5000. 500 by default.

name: analysis.terrain_profile
description: Read the ground elevation along a line, and answer how it rises and falls.

layer.description: Layer id or name to run along, instead of the two points.

samples.description: How many points to read the elevation at, 10 to 200. 100 by default.

name: analysis.travel_time
description: Draw how far a vehicle gets from one point within given minutes, one polygon per band.

lon.description: Longitude of the point travelled from.

lat.description: Latitude of the point travelled from.

bands.description: Minutes to reach, comma separated. "5, 10, 15" by default.

profile.description: What is travelling. car by default.

name: analysis.viewshed
description: Work out what an observer standing at a point can see, and draw the visible ground.

height_m.description: How far the observer's eyes are above the ground, in metres. 2 by default.

radius_m.description: How far out to look, in metres. 1000 by default.

name: basemap.set
description: Put a basemap under the layers.

name: camera.fly_to
description: Fly the camera to a longitude and latitude.

height.description: Height above the ground in metres.

heading.description: Compass bearing in degrees, 0 is north.

pitch.description: Tilt in degrees, negative looks down at the ground.

name: data.add_geojson
description: Draw GeoJSON given here directly on the map. For a result you already hold, a handful of features at most. Use data.import_url for anything at a URL or larger than that.

geojson.description: The GeoJSON itself: a FeatureCollection, a Feature, or a bare geometry.

color.description: CSS colour for the features, blue by default.

name: data.add_service
description: Add a map service as a layer, from its URL.

type.description: Which kind of service the URL serves.

url.description: Service URL. WMTS and XYZ take a {z}/{x}/{y} tile template.

name: data.add_tileset
description: Load a 3D tileset from its URL onto the globe and fly the camera to it.

url.description: URL of the tileset.json to load.

name.description: Name for the layer in the layer list.

name: data.export
description: Download one vector layer as a file.

format.description: Which format to write, geojson by default.

name: data.import_url
description: Import a data file from a URL and draw it on the map.

url.description: URL of the file to import.

name.description: Name for the layer, the file name by default.

format.description: The file's format, read from the URL by default.

name: dataset.draw_branch
description: Draw one branch of a dataset on the map, at its head or at a past moment.

branch.description: Branch id or name, main by default.

at.description: ISO 8601 moment to draw the branch as it stood then.

name: dataset.list
description: List the versioned datasets and the branches each one has.

name: find_feature
description: Find features whose properties carry some text, with the longitude and latitude of each.

query.description: Text to look for, case does not matter.

layer.description: Layer id or name to search, or every layer.

name: history.show_at
description: Show every asset as it stood at a past moment, instead of live.

name: history.show_live
description: Follow the live readings again, after showing a past moment.

name: layers.add_heatmap
description: Draw one layer's points as a heatmap, which switches the map to the maplibre renderer.

radius.description: How far one point spreads, in pixels.

intensity.description: How hot the heatmap reads overall.

name: layers.add_hexbin
description: Bin one layer's points into extruded hexagons, which switches the map to the maplibre renderer.

elevation_scale.description: How tall a hexagon stands for the points in it.

name: layers.add_scatter
description: Draw one layer's points as filled circles, which switches the map to the maplibre renderer.

color.description: CSS colour of the circles. Violet by default.

name: layers.move
description: Move one layer in the drawing order.

name: layers.remove
description: Take one layer off the map.

name: layers.set_color
description: Paint one vector layer a single colour.

color.description: A css colour, e.g. #38bdf8 or teal.

name: layers.set_opacity
description: Set how opaque one layer draws.

name: layers.set_visible
description: Show or hide one layer.

visible.description: true shows the layer, false hides it.

name: layers.shade_by
description: Colour one vector layer by the values in a column.

column.description: The feature property to shade by.

name: live.create_feed
description: Create a producer that may send readings into the live document.

interval_seconds.description: How often the producer reports, in seconds.

name: live.join
description: Join a live document, so edits and readings are shared with everyone in it.

name: live.leave
description: Leave the live document this session is in.

name: live.list
description: List the live documents this account can join.

name: live.remove_feed
description: Delete a feed, so its producer can no longer send readings.

name: live.set_asset_rule
description: Colour the assets on a layer by their latest reading of one kind.

default_color.description: Colour for an asset with no reading in range.

offline_color.description: Colour for an asset agora stopped hearing from.

name: marker.add
description: Drop a marker on the map at a longitude and latitude.

color.description: CSS colour of the marker. Red by default.

name: project.list
description: List the projects this account can open.

name: project.open
description: Open a project, putting its saved map on screen.

name: renderer.set
description: Draw the map with the Cesium globe or with MapLibre, and optionally switch tab.

renderer.description: cesium for the 3D globe, maplibre for the faster vector renderer

tab.description: globe for the 3D view, map for the 2D view

name: scenario.compare
description: Compare two branches of a dataset side by side, with the ground each one covers.

base_branch.description: Branch id or name to compare against.

scenario_branch.description: Branch id or name being proposed.

distance.description: How far a feature reaches, in metres. 50 by default.

base_at.description: ISO 8601 moment to draw the base branch at.

scenario_at.description: ISO 8601 moment to draw the scenario branch at.

name: scenario.stop
description: Stop the running comparison and take both branches off the map.

name: scene.clear
description: Remove every marker and drawn entity from the map.

name: scene.clipping
description: Cut the globe open along one axis to see inside it.

on.description: true cuts the globe, false puts it back whole.

axis.description: Earth-fixed axis the cut is made along. z by default.

position.description: Where along the axis the cut falls, 0 to 100. 50 cuts through the earth's centre.

name: scene.screenshot
description: Download a PNG picture of the globe as it looks now.

name: scene.shadows
description: Light the globe from the sun at a date and time of day, casting shadows from buildings and terrain.

on.description: true casts shadows, false leaves the globe lit flat.

date.description: The day the sun is placed on, as yyyy-mm-dd. Today by default.

hour.description: Hour of the local day, 0 to 24, fractions allowed. 12 by default.

darkness.description: How dark a shadow falls, 0 to 1. 0.3 by default.

soft_shadows.description: true softens the shadow edges. true by default.

name: split_view.set
description: Show the map in one pane or in several side by side.

active.description: true for several panes, false for one

layout.description: twoAcross for two panes, grid for four

name: sql.attach_url
description: Attach a remote CSV or Parquet file as a table SQL can query.

name.description: Name to query it as, the file name by default.

format.description: The file's format, read from the URL by default.

name: stac.add_asset
description: Put one asset of a STAC item on the map, the way its kind allows.

item.description: Item id, as stac.search lists it.

asset.description: Asset key, as stac.search lists it.

name: stac.search
description: Search one collection of a STAC catalog for items, listing the assets each one carries.

bbox.description: west,south,east,north in degrees. The current view by default.

name: tileset.reset_style
description: Take any colouring, fading and point size back off every 3D tileset on the globe, so the tiles draw as they came.

name: tileset.set_opacity
description: Fade every 3D tileset on the globe to a uniform white at the opacity given, which also takes off any colouring it had.

name: tileset.set_point_size
description: Draw the points of every 3D tileset on the globe at a size in pixels, which also takes off any colouring it had.

size.description: Width of one point in pixels, above 0. Only a point cloud has points to draw.

name: tileset.shade_by_classification
description: Colour every 3D tileset on the globe by its LIDAR classification codes, so ground, vegetation, buildings and water each take a colour.

name: tileset.shade_by_height
description: Colour every 3D tileset on the globe by height band, green near the ground through red at the top.

name: tileset.shade_by_property
description: Colour every 3D tileset on the globe by one feature property's values.

property.description: Feature property the colours are spread over, as the tileset names it.
